Fixed 2026-11-23, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#750, Experiment A). Eight arms on track-p 13151fb5: ctl (shipped) and the single removal of each new shipped-on mode: nomixed (explore_mixed 0), noleash (the three flow_leash switches 0), nohall (light_hallway_repeat_guard 0), nodear (town_prepared_poison 0 and town_prepared_ccw 0), nopot (item_test_unknown_potions 0), notrap (the three trap rules 0), noscum (stair_scum 0); breadth-first off is reborn-bfsnow (#695). Pilot, then the ladder classes-1800 starts 1-360 (verysmall, small-rest, medium); big and full on the owner's word.
Tier small-rest: starts 46-90, 100,000 turns.
Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart; identical plays per arm (an arm that plays ctl's keys was not exercised). Report per arm against ctl: deaths and causes (exact McNemar), deaths at CL <= 2, DL3 and DL5 reached, mean CL, per class. Descriptive (RULES 14).
